desc: Implement and test the baseline multiple-count sieve with descending assignment, including K=1 and K=N special cases.
Optimize input parsing and output writing for N up to 1.2e6, using chunked output if needed.
Validate edge cases: K=1, K=N, max(A)=1, all values equal, and many duplicate values.
If the baseline approach fails sample tests or is too slow/memory-heavy, switch to an alternative based on divisor accumulation using smallest-prime-factor divisor generation for distinct values.
Consider early-break counting for valid divisors and other micro-optimizations if the baseline is close to the time limit.
